# storagedaddy

> Open-source Mac storage analyzer for developers. Download now and get all future versions free forever.

## Product
- [Product guide](https://storage.daddyrad.com/index.md): Features, system requirements, cleanup safeguards, privacy and archive limitations.
- [Download](https://storage.daddyrad.com/download): Signed and notarized Apple silicon macOS app.
- [Source and feedback](https://github.com/sarthakagrawal927/storagedaddy): MIT source and GitHub issues.
